items.title_zh: 白宫采用“超级智能”术语并推出由 SI 驱动的 America.gov
items.title_en: The White House Adopts "Super Intelligence" Terminology and Launches SI-Powered America.gov
items.summary_zh: 据《国家法律评论》报道，白宫已采用“超级智能”（Super Intelligence，简称 SI）的提法，并推出由 SI 技术支持的 America.gov 网站。此举显示美国政府在官方话语与公共平台上加速引入前沿 AI 概念，可能对后续监管方向与公众沟通产生影响。目前报道未披露该网站的具体功能、所用模型或上线时间等细节。
items.summary_en: The White House Adopts "Super Intelligence" Terminology and Launches SI-Powered America.gov The National Law Review
items.why_zh: 白宫在官方话语和平台上引入“超级智能”概念，可能预示美国 AI 政策与监管风向的变化。
items.why_en: The White House's adoption of "super intelligence" language and an SI-powered government site could signal shifting U.S. AI policy and regulatory direction.

items.title_zh: AWS 推出 AI 智能体审计客户云环境
items.title_en: AWS Launches AI Agent to Audit Customer Cloud Environments
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊云科技（AWS）推出了一款 AI 智能体（AI Agent），用于审计客户的云环境。据 PYMNTS.com 报道，该工具旨在帮助客户检查云环境的配置与安全状况，可能提升合规与安全审计的效率。报道未披露该智能体的具体功能、定价或可用范围。此举延续了云厂商将 AI 智能体引入运维与安全管理的趋势，或对企业的云成本与安全实践产生影响。
items.summary_en: AWS Launches AI Agent to Audit Customer Cloud Environments PYMNTS.com
items.why_zh: 云厂商用 AI 智能体自动化安全与合规审计，可能改变企业云管理的成本与效率。
items.why_en: Cloud providers using AI agents for automated security and compliance audits could reshape enterprise cloud management.

items.title_zh: 新墨西哥州立大学 Hunt 中心启动 AI 计划，助力 Borderplex 创业生态
items.title_en: NMSU’s Hunt Center launches AI initiative to strengthen Borderplex entrepreneurship ecosystem
items.summary_zh: 新墨西哥州立大学（NMSU）旗下的 Hunt 中心宣布发起一项人工智能计划，目标是强化 Borderplex 地区的创业生态系统。Borderplex 通常指横跨美国新墨西哥州、得州埃尔帕索与墨西哥华雷斯城的边境经济带。该计划意在借助 AI 工具与资源为当地创业者提供支持，并推动区域创新与经济发展。目前公开信息未披露该计划的具体投入金额、时间表或合作方。
items.summary_en: NMSU’s Hunt Center launches AI initiative to strengthen Borderplex entrepreneurship ecosystem New Mexico State University
items.why_zh: 高校创业中心把 AI 作为区域经济发展抓手，反映 AI 正从科技中心向边境地区创业生态扩散。
items.why_en: It shows universities positioning AI as a regional economic development tool beyond major tech hubs.

items.title_zh: AI伦理研究：DeepSeek对男女近乎一视同仁，美系模型却“区别对待”
items.title_en: AI Ethics Study: DeepSeek Nearly Gender-Neutral, US Models Show Bias
items.summary_zh: AI伦理研究：DeepSeek对男女近乎一视同仁，美系模型却“区别对待” 新浪财经
items.summary_en: An AI ethics study finds that DeepSeek treats men and women almost equally, while some U.S.-developed models show differential treatment. The findings highlight ongoing concerns about gender bias in AI systems.
items.why_zh: 研究揭示不同大模型在性别公平性上的显著差异，提醒关注训练数据与对齐带来的偏见。
items.why_en: The study underscores significant gender-fairness differences across major models, raising concerns about bias in training data and alignment.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 中上线服装与配饰虚拟试穿功能
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches Virtual Try-On for Clothes and Accessories in ChatGPT
items.summary_zh: 据 TechRepublic 报道，OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 中推出了面向服装和配饰的虚拟试穿功能。用户可在对话界面内预览衣物、配饰穿戴在自己身上的效果，这类能力此前多见于电商平台和专门的试穿应用。此举意味着 ChatGPT 正从纯文本助手向带有视觉与购物场景的多模态产品延伸，可能对电商导购和零售体验产生影响。具体支持的品类范围与开放地区等信息，报道未详细说明。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Launches Virtual Try-On for Clothes and Accessories in ChatGPT TechRepublic
items.why_zh: 把虚拟试穿放进 ChatGPT，意味着 OpenAI 正把多模态能力直接接入电商购物场景。
items.why_en: It signals OpenAI pushing multimodal AI directly into e-commerce shopping experiences.

items.title_zh: n1.care 推出 AI 临床智能平台
items.title_en: n1.care launches AI clinical intelligence platform
items.summary_zh: 据 AuntMinnie 报道，n1.care 正式发布其 AI 临床智能平台，面向医疗场景提供临床相关的人工智能支持。报道披露的核心信息是平台的发布本身，具体功能模块、适配的科室或影像类型以及临床验证情况尚未在现有摘要中说明。此类平台通常旨在帮助临床医生整合与分析医疗数据、辅助决策。其实际落地效果与合规路径仍有待后续信息验证。
items.summary_en: n1.care launches AI clinical intelligence platform AuntMinnie
items.why_zh: 又一家公司切入临床 AI 赛道，说明医疗智能化仍是 AI 落地最热的领域之一。
items.why_en: Another entrant in clinical AI underscores healthcare as a hotbed for AI adoption.

items.title_zh: 焕新极氪 001 配色上新：推出哑光岩灰车色、冰川灰内饰
items.title_en: Refreshed Zeekr 001 Gains Matte Rock Grey Exterior and Glacier Grey Interior
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 2 日消息，极氪汽车今日宣布焕新极氪 001 色彩上新，推出全新外饰色“哑光岩灰”以及全新内饰色“冰川灰”。2026 年 10 月 1 日-10 月 31 日，下定焕新极氪 001 可享更多限时权益。 IT之家注意到，焕新极氪 001 于 2025 年 10 月 11 日上市， 售价 26.98 万元起 ，可限时叠加 1 万元置换金。 焕新极氪 001 全系标配 900V 全栈高压架构，实现 CLTC 综合工况续航里程最长达到 810 公里；实现电池最大充电倍率 12C，电量 10%-80% 充电最快仅需 7 分钟；实现双电机最大马力 925 匹，零百加速最快 2.83 秒，最高车速达到 280 公里 / 小时。 底盘操控方面，该车全系标配 CCD 电磁减振系统和智能魔毯功能，并升级搭载了闭式双腔空气悬架。辅助驾驶方面，全系标配千里浩瀚 H7 辅助驾驶系统，全系标配激光雷达，并搭载 NVIDIA DRIVE Thor-U 芯片 700TOPS 算力。 值得一提的是，极氪于 10 月 1 日发布“极氪 001 车型更新计划预告”， 正式宣布 2027 款极氪 001 计划于 2027 年第一季度上市 。2027 款极氪 001 将延续经典原创猎装造型，并保持全栈 900V 高压架构等核心硬核实力；在此基础上，新车将进一步强化功能配置舒适度、提供更多个性化风格选项，…

The car comes standard with a 900V architecture, up to 810 km CLTC range, 12C charging (10-80% in as little as 7 minutes), 925 hp, 0-100 km/h in 2.83 s, CCD dampers, dual-chamber air suspension, lidar and Nvidia Drive Thor-U. Zeekr also said a 2027 model-year Zeekr 001 is planned for Q1 2027.
items.why_zh: 显示中国车企正把 900V 高压平台、激光雷达与高算力智驾芯片下放到 26.98 万元级车型，并提前两年预告改款，反映智能化竞争的节奏。
items.why_en: It shows how Chinese EV makers are pushing 900V platforms, lidar and high-compute ADAS chips down to ~270,000-yuan cars while teasing future model years years in advance.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 拟感恩节前启动 2 万亿美元 IPO
items.title_en: Anthropic Targets $2 Trillion IPO Before Thanksgiving. Here’s Why $518 Billion May Be the Number That Matters Most.
items.summary_zh: 据 Barchart 报道，Anthropic 计划在感恩节前推进 IPO，目标估值约 2 万亿美元，并指出 5180 亿美元可能才是最值得关注的数字。所给信息仅有标题与来源，未说明该数字的具体含义，也未披露发行规模、承销安排或时间表等细节。若该估值成立，Anthropic 将成为规模最大的上市 AI 公司之一。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Targets $2 Trillion IPO Before Thanksgiving. Here’s Why $518 Billion May Be the Number That Matters Most. Barchart.com
items.why_zh: 若 2 万亿美元估值成真，前沿 AI 实验室的资本市场地位将再上一个量级，也会重塑 AI 行业融资格局。

items.summary_en: All In FutureTech Alliance Inc. Launches New Digital Platform for Consumers and Businesses, Advancing Its AI-Enabled Global Services Strategy WBOC TV

items.title_zh: 桌面 AI 超算新选择：英伟达 NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB 内存版正式发布，4999 美元
items.title_en: Nvidia Launches 64GB DGX Spark Desktop AI Computer at $4,999
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 2 日消息，英伟达今天正式对外披露 DGX Spark 产品更新，推出 64GB 内存版本 DGX Spark 桌面 AI 计算机，起售价 4,999 美元 （现汇率约合 33,566 元人民币） ，将于 10 月 23 日正式发售，宏碁、戴尔、华硕、技嘉、微星、H3C 等众多 OEM 厂商均会推出基于该平台的整机产品。 官方此前推出的 128GB 版本同步更新定价，128GB FE 版本售价 6,950 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 46,666 元人民币） 。 硬件层面，DGX Spark 基于 GB10 Grace‑Blackwell 超算芯片，依靠统一内存架构打通 CPU 与 GPU 内存空间，本次新增 64GB 内存版本，整机总内存 64GB，系统预留约 8GB 内存，可供模型权重与 KV 缓存使用的内存空间约 56GB，支持 NVFP4 量化格式，能够流畅部署 Gemma4 26B、Qwen3.8‑27B、Meta Muse Glimmer、Nemotron3.5 Lightning 等主流开源大模型，模型加载完成后还留有充足内存余量用于 KV 缓存，支撑长上下文推理任务。 该设备最大的亮点之一是原生具备多机集群扩展能力，内置 ConnectX‑7 高速网卡，搭配全新 NVIDIA Sync 工具套件，普通开发者无需深厚网络运维知识，就可以搭建多节…
items.summary_en: Nvidia detailed an updated DGX Spark line, adding a 64GB desktop AI computer starting at $4,999 that ships October 23, with OEM systems from Acer, Dell, Asus, Gigabyte, MSI and H3C; the 128GB FE version is now $6,950. Built on the GB10 Grace-Blackwell chip with unified memory, it leaves roughly 56GB for model weights and KV cache, supports NVFP4 and can run open models such as Gemma4 26B, Qwen3.8-27B, Meta Muse Glimmer and Nemotron3.5 Lightning. ConnectX-7 networking and the Nvidia Sync toolkit enable native multi-node clustering.
items.why_zh: 它把数据中心级的 Grace-Blackwell 架构、统一内存与多机集群能力下放到桌面，显著降低本地大模型推理与私有化部署的门槛。
items.why_en: It brings data-center-grade Grace-Blackwell silicon, unified memory and multi-node clustering to the desktop, lowering the barrier to local LLM inference and private deployment.

items.title_zh: 黑石与多家银行为博通 AI 芯片交易筹集 600 亿美元

items.title_zh: Anthropic 招股书警告：美国政府的态度会影响公司与客户的关系，甚至波及人类文明
items.title_en: Anthropic Prospectus Warns US Government Stance Could Hit Customer Ties — and Civilization
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 2 日消息，路透社今天（2 日）公布的 Anthropic IPO 招股书中提出了一条警告：美国政府对公司及其技术的态度不仅会影响政府业务，还可能 波及商业客户和合作伙伴 。 企业在招股文件中提示政策变化可能影响经营并不罕见，承接政府合同的企业尤其如此。SpaceX 就在 IPO 文件中称， 与美国政府机构保持良好关系对公司至关重要 ，一旦关系恶化，维持现有业务和争取新业务的能力都可能受到严重影响。 Anthropic 提示的风险则不止于政府业务。招股书指出， 美国政府如何看待 Anthropic 及其行为，可能进一步影响客户、合作伙伴和其他商业关系，甚至波及人类文明 。文件警告，先进 AI 可能给人类带来灾难性甚至生存性风险。 Anthropic 正紧锣密鼓地筹备 IPO，凭借从 AI 技术中获利的前景，公司估值有望达到 2 万亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 13.43 万亿元人民币） 。报道认为，由这样一家公司作出上述风险警告并不寻常。 Anthropic 称，来自政府机构合同的收入 占全年收入不到 1% 。 招股书还列举了过去一年与美国政府的数次交涉，用来说明政府行动可能给公司业务带来的风险。 今年 2 月，白宫下令 联邦机构停用 Anthropic 的模型 ，美国国防部随后将 Anthropic 列为“对国家安全构成供应链风险的企业”。Anthropi…
items.summary_en: Anthropic's IPO prospectus, reported by Reuters, warns that how the US government views the company and its technology could affect not only government business but also commercial customers, partners and other relationships — and even civilization itself, citing catastrophic or existential risks from advanced AI. Anthropic, targeting a valuation of up to $2 trillion, says government contracts account for under 1% of annual revenue, and recounts clashes over the past year including a February White House order for federal agencies to stop using its models and a Pentagon supply-chain-risk designation.
items.why_zh: 一家估值有望达 2 万亿美元的 AI 公司把“人类文明风险”和监管敌意写进招股书，凸显前沿 AI 与政府之间的紧张关系。
items.why_en: A company seeking a $2 trillion valuation listing civilization-level risk and regulatory hostility in its prospectus highlights the tense relationship between frontier AI labs and governments.

items.title_zh: 多方对话中的反馈信号预测：诊断、基准与性能上限
items.title_en: Multi-Party Backchannel Prediction: a Diagnosis, a Benchmark, and a Ceiling
items.summary_zh: 该论文指出，反馈信号（backchannel）预测此前几乎只在双人对话中研究。作者基于 AMI 语料构建多方基准，包含来自 171 场会议、190 位说话人的 682 个“掩蔽听众”视图和 18,697 个反馈事件，并采用人物不重叠的留出划分。实验显示，最先进的双人模型零样本应用于会议音频时仅相当于随机水平（AUROC 0.499），但其冻结的声学特征仍有信息量：线性探针可达 0.704，重新训练预测器可提升至 0.751，说明瓶颈更多在建模方式而非特征本身。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.01488v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Backchannel prediction has been studied almost entirely in dyadic conversation. We introduce a multi-party benchmark based on the AMI corpus, comprising 682 masked-listener views from 171 meetings, 190 speakers, and 18,697 backchannel events, with a person-disjoint held-out split. A state-of-the-art dyadic model applied zero-shot to meeting audio performs at chance (AUROC 0.499); nevertheless, its frozen acoustic features remain informative: a linear probe reaches 0.704, and retraining the predictor raises performance to 0.751. Retraining revea…
items.why_zh: 它表明双人对话模型无法直接迁移到多方会议场景，并提供了一个可复现的基准与明确的性能改进路径。
items.why_en: It shows dyadic dialogue models do not transfer directly to multi-party meetings, while providing a reproducible benchmark and a clear path to improvement.

items.title_zh: 语言模型预训练中深度顺序的持久性：块旁路响应如何随训练变化
items.title_en: Persistent Depth Ordering amid Shifting Block-Bypass Responses in Language Model Pretraining
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文关注语言模型预训练过程中内部组织结构的演化问题。作者指出，层干预（layer interventions）被广泛用于探测模型内部组织，但多数分析只考察单一训练检查点，忽略了模型表示与计算在整个预训练过程中不断变化，因此无法区分哪些依赖深度的干预响应反映了持久的结构，哪些只是训练过程中的暂时现象。研究采用单块恒等旁路（single-block identity bypass），在固定的 teacher-forced 上下文上，跨越五条已发布的训练轨迹、共 11 个模型—领域组合进行考察。题目暗示其核心发现是：尽管块旁路响应会随训练发生转移，深度排序仍具有持久性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.01165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layer interventions are widely used to probe the internal organization of language models, yet most analyses examine a single training checkpoint even though model representations and computations evolve throughout pretraining. This leaves open which depth-dependent intervention responses reflect persistent organization and which are transient consequences of training. We study this question using single-block identity bypass on fixed teacher-forced contexts across five released trajectories and 11 model-domain combinations. We find that block-by…
items.why_zh: 它提出了一个方法学警示：仅凭单一检查点解读层干预结果可能得出错误结论，而跨训练轨迹的对比能揭示模型深度结构中真正稳定的部分。
items.why_en: It warns that interpreting layer interventions from a single checkpoint can be misleading, and shows that comparing across training trajectories reveals what is truly stable in a model's depth organization.

Meta spokesperson Andy Stone pushed back on this re…

items.title_zh: 莱斯大学研究人员将用 NASA 的 AI 模型改进飓风风险评估
items.title_en: Rice researchers to use NASA AI model to improve hurricane risk estimates
items.summary_zh: 据莱斯大学消息，该校研究人员将采用 NASA 的 AI 模型来改进飓风风险评估。该工作旨在提升对飓风风险的估计能力，服务于防灾与风险管理。原文未披露所用模型的具体名称、研究时间安排及预期指标。
items.summary_en: Rice researchers to use NASA AI model to improve hurricane risk estimates Rice University
items.why_zh: 把 AI 模型引入飓风风险评估，有望让防灾决策和保险定价建立在更精细的预测之上。
items.why_en: Applying AI to hurricane risk estimation could give disaster planning and insurance pricing a more accurate predictive basis.

items.title_zh: 用自主 AI 重新定义企业智能
items.title_en: Redefining enterprise intelligence with autonomous AI
items.summary_zh: 文章指出，企业 AI 已不再是未来设想，而是进入了全面运行阶段：模型能力提升的速度超过多数组织的吸收能力，而性能成本持续下降。全球 AI 投资预计在 2026 年达到 2.5 万亿美元，同比增长 44%。但对许多企业而言，这些投入带来了碎片化：智能被困在各自孤岛中，例如销售智能体不知道尚未关闭的支持工单，营销系统在做个性化时也看不到财务部门已掌握的客户信息。文章主张以自主 AI 打通这些职能壁垒。
items.summary_en: Enterprise AI is no longer a future ambition. It is in full operational flight. Model capabilities are advancing faster than most organizations can absorb, while the cost of performance continues to fall. Globally, AI investment is set to reach $2.5 trillion in 2026, up 44% from the previous year. For many enterprises, this investment has produced fragmentation. Intelligence can accumulate in silos so that sales agents are unaware of open support tickets, for instance, or marketing systems are personalizing content without visibility into what finance already knows about a customer. Each funct…
items.why_zh: 它点出了企业 AI 投入高增长与内部数据、智能割裂之间的核心矛盾，这正是自主智能体要解决的关键问题。
items.why_en: It highlights the central tension between soaring enterprise AI spending and siloed internal intelligence — precisely the problem autonomous agents aim to solve.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 申报文件披露政府行为风险
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO Filing Outlines Government Action Risks for Commercial Ecosystem
items.summary_zh: 据 PYMNTS.com 报道，Anthropic 在其 IPO 申报文件中，将政府行为可能带来的风险明确列为影响公司商业生态的因素之一。申报材料提示投资者，监管与政策层面的不确定性可能对其业务与合作生态造成冲击。作为备受关注的人工智能公司，Anthropic 的招股披露让外界首次系统看到其如何评估政策环境对商业模式的影响。
items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO Filing Outlines Government Action Risks for Commercial Ecosystem PYMNTS.com
items.why_zh: 头部 AI 公司在招股书中把政府行为列为风险，凸显政策监管正成为 AI 商业化的核心变量。
items.why_en: A leading AI firm naming government action as a risk in its filing underscores how policy and regulation have become central to AI commercialization.

items.title_zh: 德国研究：工业 AI 创造 1200 亿欧元收入
items.title_en: German Study Finds Industrial AI Driving €120 Billion in Revenue
items.summary_zh: 据 CircleID 援引的一项德国研究，工业领域的人工智能应用正在带动约 1200 亿欧元的收入。研究显示，AI 在制造业等工业场景中的落地已成为实实在在的收入来源，而非停留在概念层面。这一数据为欧洲工业界加速采用 AI 提供了量化依据。
items.summary_en: German Study Finds Industrial AI Driving €120 Billion in Revenue CircleID
items.why_zh: 工业 AI 被量化出千亿欧元级收入，说明 AI 在实体经济中的价值正在被验证。
items.why_en: Quantifying industrial AI at the hundred-billion-euro level shows AI's value is being proven in the real economy, not just in tech.

items.why_en: Burry's comments highlight market concerns about an AI bubble and the potential ripple effects of OpenAI's IPO on tech giants.

items.why_zh: 主流财经媒体质疑 AI 明星公司的上市逻辑，反映市场对 AI 估值与治理的审视正在加深。
items.why_en: A major financial outlet questioning a star AI firm's listing logic reflects growing scrutiny of AI valuations and governance.

items.title_zh: Meta 预热雷朋 Display 眼镜 2026 年下半年大型更新：改进导航功能、支持控制通知推送、Hologram 虚拟化身...
items.title_en: Meta Previews Major Second-Half 2026 Update for Ray-Ban Display Glasses: Smarter Navigation, Notification Controls, Hologram Avatars
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 2 日消息，Meta 现已公布雷朋 Display 眼镜 2026 年下半年大型更新详情，主要改进导航体验、通知功能、视频通话功能等。 在导航方面，Meta 进一步改善了步行时的语音功能。此前系统会直接播报街道名称，例如“在第三街左转”，而在更新后， 眼镜会更多结合用户眼前的实际环境进行描述，例如提示“在前方黄色房子处左转”，让语音导航更加自然 。同时官方还为导航新增“骑行”和“公共交通”两种模式。 在通知功能方面，用户现在能够自由控制眼镜显示的通知，并选择需要关闭的通知类型，从而进一步减少无关信息对使用体验的干扰。 此外，Meta 计划在今年晚些时候向美国地区参与 Early Access 计划的用户推送 Hologram 虚拟化身功能 ，首批支持 WhatsApp 视频通话。 用户需要通过 Meta AI 应用扫描自己的面部，并录制约 1 分钟的语音样本来创建 Hologram。完成设置后，当用户佩戴 Meta Ray-Ban Display 拨打或接听 WhatsApp 视频电话时，对方将看到一个完全由 AI 生成的用户虚拟化身，其面部表情主要根据眼镜麦克风采集到的语音信息实时生成。 此外，Meta 计划在今年晚些时候为 Ray-Ban Display 加入“Explore”应用，可以看作是一个“App 推荐位”，能够直接在眼镜上展示和推荐 Meta 认为…
items.summary_en: Meta detailed a major second-half 2026 update for its Ray-Ban Display glasses, improving navigation with environment-aware voice cues such as 'turn left at the yellow house,' adding cycling and public transit modes, and giving users control over which notifications appear. Later this year it plans to roll out Hologram avatars to US Early Access users, starting with WhatsApp video calls, plus an on-glasses 'Explore' app for content recommendations.
items.why_zh: 这是 Meta 将 AI 眼镜从信息显示推向“环境理解 + AI 化身”的关键一步，也显示可穿戴设备正成为其 AI 战略的重要落点。
items.why_en: It marks a step toward AI glasses that understand the environment and generate AI avatars, reinforcing wearables as a core part of Meta's AI strategy.

items.summary_en: Despite IPO jitters and AI safety worries, Anthropic sticks to a 2026 offering SiliconANGLE

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 2 日消息，极氪汽车今日宣布，焕新极氪 007GT 色彩上新，带来全新外饰色河谷绿、全新内饰色墨绿。2026 年 10 月 1 日-10 月 31 日，下定焕新极氪 007GT 可享更多限时权益。 IT之家注意到，焕新极氪 007/007GT 于今年 4 月正式上市，定价 20.39 万元起，限时 19.39 万元起。系列车型标配 19 英寸轮毂，其中焕新极氪 007 前脸新增动感通风口造型，并提供碳纤维套件选装服务，强化运动属性。两款车型搭载算力更强的 NVIDIA DRIVE Thor-U 智驾芯片 ，智能化水平显著提升。 规格方面，焕新极氪 007 长宽高为 4858（4880）x 1900 x 1450mm，轴距 2925mm。而 007GT 车身尺寸微调至 4858（4880） x 1900 x 1460（1445）mm， 轴距维持 2925mm 。 两款新车均基于 900V 高压架构打造，提供单电机与双电机两种动力配置。单电机版最大功率 370kW，双电机版前后电机分别输出 215kW 与 370kW。车辆匹配麒麟电池， 最高续航达 905 公里 ，百公里加速最快仅需 2.73 秒。
items.summary_en: Zeekr announced new color options for the updated 007GT, adding a 'River Valley Green' exterior and 'Ink Green' interior, with limited-time perks for orders placed in October 2026. The refreshed 007/007GT line, launched in April from RMB 203,900, features NVIDIA DRIVE Thor-U chips, a 900V architecture, CATL Kirin batteries, up to 905 km range and a 2.73-second 0-100 km/h sprint.
items.why_zh: 虽然只是配色更新，但反映出车企正以频繁的个性化选项和限时权益维持智能电动车产品的市场热度。
items.why_en: Though only a color refresh, it shows automakers using frequent personalization options and limited-time perks to sustain interest in smart EVs.

items.title_zh: 独家：Anthropic IPO 招股书警告，政府态度可能损害客户关系
items.title_en: EXCLUSIVE: Anthropic warns government attitudes may hurt customer ties, IPO prospectus shows

items.summary_en: EXCLUSIVE: Anthropic warns government attitudes may hurt customer ties, IPO prospectus shows Reuters
items.why_zh: 头部 AI 公司在招股书中主动披露政治与监管风险，说明政府关系已成为 AI 商业模式的实质变量。
items.why_en: A leading AI firm flagging political and regulatory risk in its filing shows government relations are now material to AI business models.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 招股书警告：美国政府行动可能损害其业务
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO prospectus warns U.S. government actions could hurt business
items.summary_zh: 据 qz.com 报道，Anthropic 在其 IPO 招股书中警告，美国政府的相关行动可能对其业务造成损害。该披露与路透社关于政府态度可能影响客户关系的独家报道相呼应，显示监管与政治因素被列为公司面临的重要风险。
items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO prospectus warns U.S. government actions could hurt business qz.com
items.why_zh: 两家媒体对同一份招股书风险披露的报道，凸显美国政策环境对头部 AI 公司经营前景的直接影响力。
items.why_en: Two outlets highlighting the same risk disclosure underscores how directly US policy affects leading AI companies' prospects.

items.title_zh: Anthropic：即便市值达 2 万亿美元 IPO，估值仍属合理
items.title_en: Anthropic: Even With A $2 Trillion IPO, Anthropic Is Fairly Valued (Private:ANTHRO)
items.summary_zh: Seeking Alpha 刊发分析文章，讨论 Anthropic 若以 2 万亿美元规模进行 IPO，其估值是否合理，并给出“估值合理”的判断。文章以私募市场标的代号 ANTHRO 指代该公司，围绕其上市前景与定价展开论证。对投资者而言，这提供了一个关于头部 AI 公司资本市场想象空间的参考视角。
items.summary_en: Anthropic: Even With A $2 Trillion IPO, Anthropic Is Fairly Valued (Private:ANTHRO) Seeking Alpha
items.why_zh: 2 万亿美元级别的 IPO 设想，反映了市场对头部 AI 公司估值的极端想象力。
items.why_en: A hypothetical $2 trillion IPO illustrates how extreme market expectations for top AI labs have become.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO：ETF 投资者需要了解什么
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO: What ETF Investors Should Know
items.summary_zh: TradingView 发布面向 ETF 投资者的内容，梳理 Anthropic 潜在 IPO 对交易所交易基金投资者意味着什么。文章关注的不是公司基本面本身，而是上市事件如何通过指数与基金产品传导到普通投资者的持仓上。对希望通过被动工具间接配置 AI 龙头的投资者，这类信息具有直接参考价值。
items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO: What ETF Investors Should Know TradingView
items.why_zh: 如果 Anthropic 上市，它可能被纳入指数并影响大量 ETF 持仓，波及被动投资者。
items.why_en: An Anthropic listing could enter indexes and ripple through many ETFs, affecting passive investors.

items.why_zh: 地方“词元工厂”落地，显示中国区域算力与 AI 基础设施竞争正在向地市一级延伸。
items.why_en: A local "token factory" shows China's regional AI infrastructure race is spreading to prefecture-level cities.

items.title_zh: 美国银行与标普全球：AI 成功的前提是治理与数据
items.title_en: Bank of America and S&P Global on why AI success starts with governance and data
items.summary_zh: 《财富》刊文介绍美国银行与标普全球的观点，认为企业 AI 项目能否成功，关键并不在于模型本身，而在于数据质量与治理体系。两家机构强调，缺乏可靠数据基础和合规治理框架，AI 落地难以规模化。这一判断呼应了企业界对 AI 投入回报与风险控制的双重关切。
items.summary_en: Bank of America and S&P Global on why AI success starts with governance and data Fortune
items.why_zh: 它把企业 AI 的焦点从模型能力拉回到数据与治理这些更基础、更难做好的环节。
items.why_en: It shifts the enterprise AI conversation from model capability back to the harder basics of data and governance.

items.title_zh: 钛度推出轻鸾 2 头戴式耳机：50mm 动圈、230g 重量，159.9 元

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 2 日消息，钛度现已在京东上架轻鸾 2 头戴式耳机，该产品主打轻量化机身，定价为 159.9 元。 京东 钛度轻鸾 2 头戴式耳机 159.9 元 直达链接 外观上，耳机提供枪灰色 / 珍珠白可选，重约 230g，外壳采用 POK 材质与准分子涂层工艺，匹配人体工学头梁，耳罩支持 90° 旋转，配备可插拔全指向 AI 降噪麦克风以过滤杂音。 该耳机搭载 50mm 发声单元，支持 7.1 游戏音效与音乐双模式，支持 2.4G、蓝牙 6.0 及有线 USB 连接，耳机内置 1000mAh 电池，IT之家附参数：
items.summary_en: Taidu has listed its Qingluan 2 headset on JD.com for 159.9 yuan, featuring a 230g body, POK shell, and 50mm drivers. It supports 7.1 gaming and music modes, 2.4G, Bluetooth 6.0, and wired USB, with a detachable AI noise-cancelling mic and a 1,000mAh battery.
items.why_zh: 百元价位产品把 AI 降噪麦克风作为卖点，说明 AI 功能正加速下沉到入门级消费硬件。
items.why_en: An entry-level headset using AI noise cancellation as a selling point shows AI features trickling down to budget hardware.

items.title_zh: AI 幻觉正让本就强势的顾客更难应付
items.title_en: AI hallucinations are making entitled customers even worse
items.summary_zh: 报道讲述纽约市服务员 Madison 的经历：她会在点餐前询问客人过敏情况，但近来多次出现险情——客人告知海鲜过敏后，仍点了汤底含贝类的鱼类菜品，理由是 ChatGPT 的说法与她不同。当服务员提醒菜品含过敏原时，部分客人会反驳，并援引 AI 的回答作为依据。报道由此讨论 AI 幻觉在现实场景中对服务人员与消费者安全带来的新压力。
items.summary_en: Madison, a server in New York City, greets every table by asking about each diner's allergies. Lately, there have been some close calls. "Sometimes people will tell me they have a shellfish allergy, and I'll come back, and they won't ask me any questions," says Madison, who asked that her last name be withheld to protect her identity. "And they'll order a fish dish that comes with a broth that is made of shellfish." When she tells them a dish contains an allergen, she's had guests push back, saying ChatGPT disagrees. "They just want to talk to ChatGPT," Madison explains. "You're allergic to sh…
items.why_zh: 当 AI 的错误答案被当作权威依据，它可能直接影响食品安全与一线服务人员的处境。
items.why_en: When AI's wrong answers are treated as authority, they can directly affect food safety and frontline workers.

items.title_zh: 如果数据中心藏进树林，还会有人反对吗？
items.title_en: If a data center is camouflaged in the woods, will anyone hate it?
items.summary_zh: 文章以圣安东尼奥市议员 Ric Galvan 的视角切入：2000 年代数据中心刚进入该市时只是不起眼的办公楼，如今已发展为占地数百万平方英尺的“超大规模”设施，承载 AI 的物理基础设施。Galvan 所在约 55 平方英里的选区已有十几个数据中心，若拟议项目落地，未来几年可能增至约 20 个，且集中在两条主干道沿线，带来压力叠加。文章由此探讨外观设计与选址能否缓解社区抵触。
items.summary_en: San Antonio City Councilmember Ric Galvan remembers when data centers first arrived in his city in the 2000s, looking like relatively unassuming office buildings. But that's changed in recent years, as data centers have grown into massive "hyperscale" facilities spanning millions of square feet and housing the physical infrastructure for AI. There are now more than a dozen data centers in Galvan's roughly 55-square-mile district, and he expects that number to grow to around 20 over the next few years if proposed projects are completed. They're clustered along two main roads, concentrating nuis…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了 AI 基础设施扩张与社区接受度之间的现实张力，选址与外观成为新的谈判筹码。
items.why_en: It reveals the real tension between AI infrastructure expansion and community acceptance, where siting and design become bargaining chips.

items.title_zh: 亚马逊发博客警告社区：不要阻挠数据中心
items.title_en: Amazon writes scary blog warning communities not to block data centers
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊呼吁公众支持 AI 数据中心项目，称否则将对美国经济与国家安全造成难以弥补的损害。AWS CEO Matt Garman 在一篇逾 3000 字的博文中回应公众对就业、电力需求和环境影响的担忧，表示美国“承受不起”在 AI 主导权竞赛中落败。他同时承认变革会带来重要疑问，但认为社交媒体与全天候新闻环境下，错误信息和谣言传播得比以往更快。
items.summary_en: Amazon is calling for people to support AI data center projects, or risk irreparable harm to the US economy and national security. In a more than 3,000 word blog posted today, Amazon web services CEO Matt Garman pushed back on public concerns around the impact that data centers may have on jobs, power demands, and the environment, saying "our nation can't afford to lose" the race for AI dominance. "With any change, there will be important questions raised, but there will also be misinformation and outright lies, and in the age of social media and 24/7 news, myths take hold faster than ever bef…
items.why_zh: 科技巨头公开施压社区，标志着数据中心选址争议已升级为全国性的政治与舆论博弈。
items.why_en: A tech giant publicly pressuring communities signals that data center siting fights have become a national political and PR battle.

items.title_zh: 两大超大规模云厂商如何从Anthropic IPO中获益
items.title_en: How The Two BIggest Hyperscalers Stand to Benefit From Anthropic’s IPO
items.summary_zh: 24/7 Wall St. 发布分析文章，探讨两大超大规模云服务商将如何从Anthropic的IPO中获益。Anthropic作为AI领域的重要公司，其上市可能为早期投资者和云合作伙伴带来巨大回报。分析可能涉及其持股价值以及云服务合作关系的深化。这凸显了AI公司与云计算巨头之间的紧密绑定。IPO将检验AI行业估值，并可能影响云厂商的竞争格局。
items.summary_en: How The Two BIggest Hyperscalers Stand to Benefit From Anthropic’s IPO 24/7 Wall St.
items.why_zh: Anthropic的IPO不仅是AI行业风向标，也将影响其云合作伙伴的财务表现和战略地位。
items.why_en: Anthropic's IPO is not only a bellwether for the AI industry but will also impact the financial performance and strategic positions of its cloud partners.

items.title_zh: Broadcom开始筹集600亿美元债务，为Anthropic的AI芯片提供资金
items.title_en: Broadcom is starting to raise $60 billion in debt to finance AI chips for Anthropic
items.summary_zh: 据qz.com报道，Broadcom已开始筹集600亿美元债务，用于为Anthropic生产AI芯片提供资金。这笔大规模融资凸显了AI芯片需求的激增以及Broadcom与Anthropic的深度合作。此举可能加速Anthropic的AI模型训练和部署，并进一步巩固Broadcom在AI芯片市场的地位。这一融资规模也反映了市场对AI算力投资的强烈信心。
items.summary_en: Broadcom is starting to raise $60 billion in debt to finance AI chips for Anthropic qz.com
items.why_zh: 600亿美元债务融资规模巨大，反映了AI基础设施投资的狂热，以及芯片厂商与AI公司之间日益紧密的绑定。
items.why_en: The $60 billion debt raise is enormous, reflecting the frenzy of AI infrastructure investment and the increasingly tight coupling between chipmakers and AI companies.

items.title_zh: 博通发债 600 亿美元资助 Anthropic AI 芯片
items.title_en: Broadcom raises $60 billion in debt to fund Anthropic AI chips
items.summary_zh: 据 Yahoo Finance 报道，博通（Broadcom）通过债务融资筹集了 600 亿美元，用于资助 Anthropic 的 AI 芯片项目。这笔巨额融资显示出博通对 AI 芯片需求的强烈信心，以及其为满足 Anthropic 算力需求所做的财务布局。此举也反映出 AI 基础设施竞赛中资本运作的规模。
items.summary_en: Broadcom raises $60 billion in debt to fund Anthropic AI chips Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 这笔巨额债务融资凸显了 AI 芯片竞赛对资本的巨大需求，以及博通与 Anthropic 深度绑定的战略。
items.why_en: The huge debt raise underscores the massive capital needs of the AI chip race and Broadcom's deep strategic alignment with Anthropic.

items.why_zh: 显示用户对AI模型行为变化和内容审核的高度敏感，可能影响AI产品的信任度。
items.why_en: It highlights users' high sensitivity to changes in AI model behavior and content moderation, which may affect trust in AI products.

items.title_zh: Anthropic目标感恩节前IPO，估值高达2万亿美元
items.title_en: Anthropic is targeting a pre-Thanksgiving IPO at up to a $2 trillion valuation
items.summary_zh: 据qz.com报道，AI公司Anthropic正计划在感恩节前进行IPO，估值可能高达2万亿美元。若成真，这将是历史上规模最大的IPO之一，凸显AI行业的热度与资本追捧。Anthropic是OpenAI的主要竞争对手之一，其上市将测试公开市场对AI公司的估值逻辑。影响：可能引发AI公司上市潮，并重塑科技行业格局。
items.summary_en: Anthropic is targeting a pre-Thanksgiving IPO at up to a $2 trillion valuation qz.com
items.why_zh: 2万亿美元估值若实现，将创下纪录，标志着AI泡沫或繁荣的顶峰，对市场影响深远。
items.why_en: A $2 trillion valuation, if achieved, would set a record and mark either the peak of an AI bubble or a boom, with far-reaching market impact.

items.summary_en: Under the trending topic #DoubaoAlsoAdjusted#, a user questions why Doubao seems to 'protect Wang Chuqin' specifically, calling it too deliberate and suspecting someone posted it intentionally. This reflects concerns about potential bias in AI assistant responses.
items.why_zh: 凸显公众对AI模型潜在偏见和人为干预的警惕，可能影响AI产品的公信力。
items.why_en: It underscores public vigilance against potential bias and human intervention in AI models, which could affect the credibility of AI products.

items.title_zh: 泄露的Anthropic IPO招股书：美国政府可能损害我们的业务
items.title_en: Leaked Anthropic IPO prospectus: The US government could hurt our business
items.summary_zh: 据Yahoo Finance报道，一份泄露的Anthropic IPO招股书显示，该公司警告美国政府可能对其业务造成伤害。这可能涉及监管压力、政策不确定性或政府合同风险等因素。作为AI安全领域的领先公司，Anthropic的担忧反映了AI行业面临的日益严格的监管环境。影响：可能影响投资者对AI公司政策风险的评估。
items.summary_en: Leaked Anthropic IPO prospectus: The US government could hurt our business Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 揭示AI公司在IPO过程中对政府监管风险的坦诚披露，凸显政策对AI行业的重要性。
items.why_en: It reveals AI companies' candid disclosure of government regulatory risks during IPO, highlighting the importance of policy to the AI industry.

items.title_zh: Amazon’s Latest Response to AI Data Center Backlash: $1 Billion
items.title_en: Amazon's Latest Response to AI Data Center Backlash: $1 Billion
items.summary_zh: Amazon’s Latest Response to AI Data Center Backlash: $1 Billion Bloomberg.com
items.summary_en: Amazon is responding to backlash over AI data centers with a $1 billion commitment, Bloomberg reports. The move comes as tech companies face growing community and environmental resistance to massive AI infrastructure.
items.why_zh: 反映AI发展带来的环境与社会挑战，以及巨头在扩张与社区关系间的平衡。
items.why_en: It reflects the environmental and social challenges brought by AI development, and how tech giants balance expansion with community relations.

items.title_zh: Broadcom融资银团据悉寻求600亿美元，用于Anthropic和其他AI公司
items.title_en: Broadcom Financing Syndicate Reportedly Seeks $60 Billion for Anthropic and Other AI Companies
items.summary_zh: 据Yahoo Finance报道，由Broadcom牵头的融资银团正寻求筹集600亿美元，为Anthropic及其他AI公司提供资金。这与早前Broadcom为Anthropic融资600亿美元的报道相呼应，但此次范围扩大至其他AI公司。如此大规模的债务融资凸显了AI芯片和基础设施投资的空前热度。影响：可能加剧AI军备竞赛，并增加相关公司的财务风险。
items.summary_en: Broadcom Financing Syndicate Reportedly Seeks $60 Billion for Anthropic and Other AI Companies Yahoo Finance
items.why_zh: 600亿美元银团贷款显示AI投资已进入巨额债务融资阶段，可能催生泡沫风险。
items.why_en: The $60 billion syndicated loan shows AI investment has entered a phase of massive debt financing, potentially fueling bubble risks.

items.title_zh: 对标英伟达平台，DeepSeek开源华为昇腾全套基础设施组件

items.summary_zh: 对标英伟达平台，DeepSeek开源华为昇腾全套基础设施组件 搜狐网
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has reportedly open-sourced a full set of infrastructure components for Huawei's Ascend chips, positioning them as a counterpart to Nvidia's platform. The move could give developers a more complete open software stack for running models on domestic Chinese AI hardware.
items.why_zh: 这是国产 AI 芯片软件生态对标英伟达的关键一步，直接影响昇腾平台的可开发性。
items.why_en: It marks a key step in building a domestic AI chip software ecosystem to rival Nvidia, directly affecting how usable the Ascend platform is for developers.

items.title_zh: 腾讯 WorkBuddy 内置模型独家支持 Space Bunny
items.title_en: Tencent WorkBuddy Becomes Exclusive Built-In Home for Space Bunny
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 2 日消息，腾讯 WorkBuddy 今日宣布内置模型独家支持 Space Bunny。 据介绍， Space Bunny 是一款 匿名 Flash 大模型 ，具备极速推理、强大的编码能力，原生支持文本、图像、视频输入，思考深度可调，上下文长达 1M。WorkBuddy 国内独家接入，2026 年 10 月 2 日至 10 月 7 日间可享限时折扣。 IT之家注意到，Space Bunny 是 2026 年 9 月 23 日上线的一款匿名 Flash 模型，拥有 100 万 Token 上下文窗口，支持文本、图像和视频输入，可调节推理强度并提供工具调用能力，强调快速推理和编程表现。 2026 年 9 月 27 日，Space Bunny 在 OpenRouter 的 Token 调用量约 3.99 万亿，在 OpenCode 约 8.3 万亿，均位居第一，连续霸榜三天 。
items.summary_en: Tencent's WorkBuddy says it now exclusively supports Space Bunny, an anonymous Flash model with 1M-token context, text/image/video input, adjustable reasoning depth and tool calling. The model reportedly topped token-usage rankings on OpenRouter and OpenCode for three straight days after launching on Sept 23, 2026.
items.why_zh: 一款登顶调用量榜单的匿名模型被平台独家接入，反映大模型分发渠道之争日益激烈。
items.why_en: An anonymous model that topped usage charts being tied to one platform highlights the escalating battle over LLM distribution channels.

items.title_zh: AI 音乐工具 Suno 新增语音生成功能
items.title_en: AI music maker Suno now generates spoken words
items.summary_zh: 以 AI 音乐生成著称的 Suno 正拓展业务边界，推出新功能 Speech，可根据脚本或提示描述生成语音。该功能已在 Suno 的网页端和移动端开启公开测试，用户可同时生成配音与配套的背景音乐。Suno 首席产品官 Jack Brody 在公告中表示，音乐始终是 Suno 的核心，但公司的愿景一直延伸到其他人类表达形式。此次语音功能的推出，意味着 Suno 正从音乐创作工具向更广义的音频内容生成平台延伸。
items.summary_en: Suno is branching out from the world of AI music, launching a new feature that generates spoken voices based on scripts or prompted descriptions. Speech is now available in public beta across Suno's web and mobile platforms, and allows you to simultaneously generate voiceovers and background music to accompany them. "Music will always be at the heart of Suno and what we build. At the same time, our vision has always extended to other forms of human expression," Suno chief product officer, Jack Brody, said in the announcement. "Today, we're expanding what's possible in Suno with Speech: the fir…
items.why_zh: 音乐生成头部产品切入语音赛道，加剧了 AI 音频内容生成的竞争。
items.why_en: A leading AI music product moving into speech intensifies competition in AI-generated audio content.

items.title_zh: 生图模型 FLUX 3 Image 发布：支持 4K 生成，可精准排布 AI 元素
items.title_en: FLUX 3 Image Launches With 4K Output and Precise Element Placement
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 2 日消息，德国 AI 公司 Black Forest Labs 今天（10 月 2 日）发布公告，宣布推出图像生成 AI 模型 FLUX 3 Image， 支持生成最高 4K 分辨率图片，输出画面在放大后仍保持丰富细节。 该模型基于 FLUX 3 基座开发，以高可控性与精细编辑能力为核心卖点。用户可在归一化的 0–1000 坐标网格上，为每个元素指定 ID、描述文本及精确边界框（格式为 [y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max]），在画面中精准排布。IT之家附上相关图片如下： 图源：gigazine 该模型单次生成最多可融入 10 张参考图像，并可为每张参考图中的对象指定出现位置。 编辑功能方面，模型可对指定区域进行修改，同时保持其他像素不变。官方称其能在像素级别维持原图内容，实现精确多轮编辑。 FLUX 3 Image 目前作为 Black Forest Labs 的付费服务提供。公司表示，开放模型版本将于数周内公开。
items.summary_en: Black Forest Labs has released FLUX 3 Image, an image model built on the FLUX 3 base that generates up to 4K images and offers fine-grained control, letting users place elements by ID, text description and precise bounding boxes on a normalized 0-1000 grid. It accepts up to 10 reference images per generation and supports pixel-level regional edits; an open model version is promised within weeks.
items.why_zh: 精准元素排布与像素级编辑能力，把生图模型的可控性推向了新的实用水平。
items.why_en: Precise element placement and pixel-level editing push image-generation controllability to a new practical level.

items.title_zh: AI伦理研究：DeepSeek对男女近乎一视同仁，美系模型却“区别对待”
items.title_en: AI Ethics Study: DeepSeek Treats Men and Women Almost Equally, While US Models Show Bias
items.summary_zh: AI伦理研究：DeepSeek对男女近乎一视同仁，美系模型却“区别对待” 新浪财经
items.summary_en: A study on AI ethics compared how different large language models handle gender, finding that DeepSeek responded to men and women in a nearly even-handed way, while some US models showed signs of differential treatment. The comparison highlights how training data and alignment choices can shape fairness across models.
items.why_zh: 性别偏见是衡量大模型公平性的关键指标，该研究提示不同模型在这一维度上差距明显，模型选型与部署前应把公平性纳入评估。
items.why_en: Gender bias is a key fairness benchmark for large language models, and this study suggests models differ markedly on it—making fairness testing a necessary step before deploying them.

items.title_zh: AI 伦理研究：DeepSeek 对男女一视同仁，美系模型却“区别对待”
items.title_en: AI Ethics Study Finds DeepSeek Treats Genders Equally While US Models Show Bias
items.summary_zh: AI 伦理研究：DeepSeek 对男女一视同仁，美系模型却“区别对待” 17173
items.summary_en: An AI ethics study comparing gender-related behavior across large models found DeepSeek treated male and female users equally, while some US-made models showed differential treatment. The finding renews attention to fairness and alignment practices in AI.
items.why_zh: 性别偏见直接关系到 AI 的公平性，也牵动不同厂商模型对齐策略的对比与审视。
items.why_en: Gender bias goes to the heart of AI fairness and invites scrutiny of how different vendors approach model alignment.

items.title_zh: K-Dense BYOK：本地运行、带哈希链实验记录的开源 AI 科研助手
items.title_en: K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook
items.summary_zh: arXiv 上发布的一篇论文介绍了 K-Dense BYOK（bring your own keys），这是一款面向各领域科学家的免费开源 AI 研究助手，直接运行在研究者自己的电脑上。研究者自行提供所选模型的访问权限（可托管也可本地运行），应用则提供其余一切：工作运行环境、科研支撑层以及完整记录。每个项目就是一个普通文件夹，因此数据、代码、结果与记录都保留在研究者自主管理的机器上，多年后无需依赖该应用也能读取。其特色在于以哈希链方式维护实验记录，增强可追溯性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.00074v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the applicati…
items.why_zh: 它在数据主权与实验可追溯性上给出了新方案，契合科研对可复现性的核心诉求。
items.why_en: It offers a fresh take on data sovereignty and experiment traceability, addressing science's core need for reproducibility.

items.title_zh: PG-SFT：在离线智能体微调中平衡能力获取与保持
items.title_en: PG-SFT: Balancing Capability Acquisition and Retention in Offline Agent Fine-Tuning
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文聚焦离线智能体轨迹上的监督微调（SFT）问题。这是训练专用工具调用智能体的常规做法，但让模型逐 Token 模仿推理与动作，可能损害基座模型的其他能力，例如通用推理、工具调用和代码生成。研究围绕“如何在智能体轨迹 SFT 中更好地平衡新能力获取与既有能力保持”展开，通过在其实验设置下比较多种基线方法，发现标准 SFT 虽能提升目标基准表现，但在其他能力上存在代价。作者据此提出了改进方法 PG-SFT。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.00949v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on offline agent trajectories is the standard approach for training specialized tool-using agents, but forcing models to imitate reasoning and actions token by token may harm other capabilities (e.g., general reasoning, tool calling, code generation) of the base model. In this work, we focus on studying \emph{how to better balance the trade-off between acquiring new capabilities and preserving existing ones during agent trace SFT}. By comparing several baselines in our setup, standard SFT improves the target benchmark…
items.why_zh: 智能体微调中的“能力遗忘”是落地工具型模型必须解决的现实问题。
items.why_en: Capability forgetting during agent fine-tuning is a practical obstacle to deploying specialized tool-using models.

items.title_zh: 超越 SOTA：为 AI 研究建立标准化的环境影响评估指标
items.title_en: Beyond State-of-the-Art: Standardising Environmental Impact Metrics for AI Research
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文指出，随着大语言模型能力与普及度提升，其环境足迹也在扩大，但机器学习界缺乏统一的碳核算规范。作者对 NeurIPS 2025 录用的 5285 篇论文做了自动化文献综述，发现环境影响报告几乎不存在。为推动可持续 AI，论文定义了用于评估模型训练效率的标准化可持续性指标，并给出便于估算的简单启发式方法，希望借此促成学界在环境成本披露上的转向。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.01116v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As the capabilities and ubiquity of Large Language Models (LLMs) grow, so does their environmental footprint. Despite calls for responsible AI, the machine learning community lacks standardised practices for carbon accounting. Our automated literature review of the 5,285 papers accepted to NeurIPS 2025 reveals that reporting of environmental impact is nearly non-existent. To catalyse a shift toward sustainable AI, we define standardised sustainability metrics for evaluating model training efficiency, accompanied by simple heuristics to estimate t…
items.why_zh: 缺乏统一的碳核算标准，让 AI 环境成本难以比较，也削弱了可持续发展的推动力。
items.why_en: Without standard carbon accounting, AI's environmental costs can't be compared, weakening the push for sustainable AI.

items.title_zh: SCOPE-AD：面向诊断智能体的序贯成本感知有序信念规划
items.title_en: SCOPE-AD: Sequential cost-aware ordinal-belief planning with energy-based models for diagnostic agents
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文提出 SCOPE-AD，一个面向阿尔茨海默病（AD）诊断的序贯决策框架。AD 诊断需要在检查成本各异、患者负担不同的条件下逐步获取证据，而现有的固定模态预测模型不会主动决定“该做哪项检查”或“现有证据是否已足以确诊”。SCOPE-AD 采用掩码感知（mask-aware）的有序模型，在“认知正常（CN）—轻度认知障碍（MCI）—AD”这一有序轴上刻画不确定性，并借助基于能量的模型进行成本感知规划，从而把 CN/MCI/AD 的分类与检查选择统一起来。该工作由 arXiv 以新投稿形式发布，摘要未给出具体实验结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.01278v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis requires sequential evidence acquisition under heterogeneous test costs and patient burden. Fixed-modality predictors do not jointly decide which test to acquire or when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. We propose SCOPE-AD (Sequential Cost-Aware Ordinal-Belief Planning with Energy-Based Models for Diagnostic Agents) for cost-aware classification of cognitively normal (CN), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD cases. A mask-aware ordinal model represents uncertainty along the ordered CN--MCI…
items.why_zh: 它把“选什么检查”和“何时可以确诊”纳入统一决策，直击真实临床诊断中成本与患者负担的核心矛盾。
items.why_en: It unifies test selection and stopping decisions, addressing the cost and patient-burden trade-offs central to real clinical diagnosis.

items.title_zh: RealCompanion：用真实长期对话评测 AI 伴侣对人的理解
items.title_en: RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations
items.summary_zh: 论文指出了一个评测困境：要检验 AI 伴侣是否真正“理解”一个人，需要这个人的真实长期记录，但这类记录属隐私，因此现有基准往往用生成出来的虚拟人物和问题，并预先规定什么才算重要。为此，作者发布 RealCompanion 基准，包含十段真实的人与 AI 伴侣之间的关系记录：最多跨越 120 天、共 27,218 条消息，以原始对话加上由对话衍生的四份文件（如用户画像、人物设定等）的形式公开。该基准旨在考察伴侣是否能记住对方说过的话、推断其为人，并判断过往信息何时与当前消息相关。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.01780v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A companion that talks with a person for months should come to understand them. It should remember what they said, infer who they are, and know when the past bears on the message in front of it. Testing this requires a real person's record, and such records are private, so benchmarks generate the person and the questions and settle in advance what matters. We release \bench, ten real relationships with an AI companion: 27,218 messages over up to 120 days, released as the conversation and four files derived from it, a profile, a persona, a chat gr…
items.why_zh: 长期记忆与人格理解是 AI 伴侣的核心能力，用真实长期对话而非合成数据来评测，能更可信地衡量其真实水平。
items.why_en: Long-term memory and personal understanding are core to AI companions, and evaluating them on real longitudinal conversations rather than synthetic data makes such claims far more credible.

items.title_zh: Mingbird：让小型开源模型在本地完成真实任务的智能体框架
items.title_en: Mingbird: A Local-First Agent Harness Enabling Small Open Models to Complete Real Tasks
items.summary_zh: 论文关注一个现实问题：2–9B 的小型开源权重模型虽然能在普通笔记本上运行，但在云端规模的智能体框架下几乎完不成真实任务，常见失败包括工具预填充撑爆上下文、自我纠错跑偏、工具示例陷入循环，以及任务被悄悄放弃。作者通过受控的单机对比和一项第三方基准给出证据，认为这些失败中有相当一部分应归因于智能体框架而非模型本身。为此他们提出 Mingbird，一个面向 Windows 与 Ollama 的本地优先智能体框架，用十项机制来弥补小模型的短板。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.02001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Small open-weight models (2-9B) run on ordinary laptops, but under cloud-scale agent harnesses they rarely complete real tasks: tool prefill overflows the context, self-correction diverges, tool demonstrations loop, and tasks are silently abandoned. We present evidence, from a controlled single-machine comparison and one third-party benchmark, that a substantial share of these failures is attributable to the harness rather than the model. We introduce Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama whose ten mechanisms compensate poi…
items.why_zh: 它提示许多“小模型不行”的结论可能是框架造成的，为本地、低成本的智能体落地提供了新思路。
items.why_en: It suggests many 'small models can't do it' failures are harness artifacts, pointing toward practical local and low-cost agent deployment.

items.title_zh: PyPottery：AI 驱动的陶器处理与发表全流程工具套件
items.title_en: PyPottery: an AI-powered end-to-end suite for pottery processing and publication
items.summary_zh: 陶瓷材料研究是考古学的支柱之一，但陶器记录在出图之后的处理流程仍高度依赖人工，成为发表的瓶颈。论文提出 PyPottery，一个开源、AI 驱动的工具套件，旨在半自动化整个陶瓷记录流程。该套件包含四个集成模块：PyPotteryScan 负责图像自动提取与手写文字识别；PyPotteryInk 负责给铅笔线稿自动上墨；PyPotteryTrace 负责语义相关的处理；以及其余模块共同覆盖从扫描到成图、再到发表准备的环节。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.02072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The study of ceramic materials constitutes a cornerstone of archaeological research, yet the post-production workflow for pottery documentation remains labor-intensive and creates significant publication bottlenecks. This paper presents PyPottery, an open-source, AI-powered suite designed to semi-automate the complete ceramic documentation pipeline. The suite comprises four integrated modules: PyPotteryScan for automated image extraction and handwriting recognition; PyPotteryInk for automatic inking of pencil drawings; PyPotteryTrace for semantic…
items.why_zh: 把 AI 用于考古记录中重复度最高、最耗时的环节，有望直接缓解陶器研究的发表瓶颈。
items.why_en: Applying AI to archaeology's most repetitive documentation steps could directly relieve publication bottlenecks in pottery research.

items.title_zh: 开源 LLM 多智能体系统：实践者遇到哪些问题、成因与解法
items.title_en: Understanding Issues, Causes and Solutions in Open-Source LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_zh: 随着基于 LLM 的多智能体系统（MAS）发展，越来越多开源项目把多智能体架构作为核心功能的基础。尽管相关研究与工程实践热度很高，但针对开源 LLM 多智能体系统开发者的实际困难、这些困难的成因以及可行解决方案的研究仍然有限。为填补这一空白，作者开展了一项实证研究，考察实践者在开发和使用此类系统时遇到的问题。该论文以 arXiv 交叉列表形式发布，摘要未披露具体研究发现与样本规模。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.00905v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: With the advancement of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS), an increasing number of opensource projects are adopting multi-agent architectures as the foundation of their core functionality. Although research and practice on MAS have attracted considerable attention, limited studies have explored the challenges faced by practitioners of open-source LLM-based MAS, the causes of these challenges, and potential solutions. To address this gap,we conducted an empirical study to understand the issues that practitioners encounter when developing and u…
items.why_zh: 从工程实践而非论文指标出发梳理多智能体系统的痛点，对正在搭建此类系统的开发者更具参考价值。
items.why_en: By mapping pain points from engineering practice rather than paper benchmarks, it offers practical guidance to developers building multi-agent systems.

items.title_zh: 可核查性而非规模：弱审查者何时能审计强编码智能体
items.title_en: Groundability, Not Scale Alone: When Weak Reviewers Can Audit Strong Coding Agents
items.summary_zh: 编码智能体可能给出看似合理、却遗漏必需行为的补丁，而冗长的执行轨迹和自信的总结往往掩盖了缺失之处，使审查变得困难。论文提出的问题是：一个名义上更弱的审查者，何时能可靠判断某个补丁是否真正解决了对应问题。作者研究了来自三个智能体的 411 条带执行标签的轨迹和 101 个受控案例；在 154 条 GPT-5.4 轨迹上发现，结构化但未经核验的证据会同时提高缺陷发现率与误拒率。随后他们引入官方执行证据作为上界诊断手段，以厘清可核查性对审查能力的影响。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.01023v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coding agents can return plausible patches that omit required behavior. These failures are hard to review because long traces and confident summaries often hide what was missed. We ask when a nominally weaker reviewer can reliably decide whether a patch solves its issue. We study 411 execution-labeled traces from three agents and 101 controlled cases. On 154 GPT-5.4 traces, structured but unchecked evidence raises both defect catch and over-rejection. We then provide official execution evidence as an upper-bound diagnostic. After choosing and f…
items.why_zh: 它指出审查能力的关键不只在模型规模，而在于证据是否“可落地核查”，为编码智能体的评测与监督设计提供了新标准。
items.why_en: It argues review capability depends less on scale than on whether evidence is groundable, offering a new standard for auditing and supervising coding agents.

items.title_zh: 用于恶意软件多分类的结构化状态空间序列模型
items.title_en: A Structured State Space Sequence Model for Multi-Class Classification of Malware
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，到 2030 年物联网设备预计将达到 400 亿台，工业、医疗、农业、汽车以及楼宇与家庭自动化等领域的技术快速推进，而这些设备大多缺乏内置安全能力，从而形成了巨大的攻击面。网络罪犯会利用漏洞发动恶意软件攻击，以入侵系统或窃取敏感数据，一旦系统被攻陷，还可能被植入勒索软件。针对这一背景，作者提出一种结构化状态空间序列模型，用于对恶意软件进行多类别分类。该文以 arXiv 交叉列表形式发布，摘要未给出具体实验数据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.01893v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: By 2030, Internet of Things (IoT) devices are projected to reach 40 billion, with fast-paced technological advancements in fields such as industry, healthcare, agriculture, automobiles, and building/home automation systems. This expansion has created a large attack surface for cybercrime, as the majority of these devices open the door for cybercriminals to exploit vulnerabilities, as they lack adequate built-in security. Cybercriminals launch malware attacks to compromise systems or steal sensitive data, and once a system is compromised, a rans…
items.why_zh: 面向海量且防护薄弱的 IoT 设备，序列建模可能为恶意软件的多类别识别提供更有效的检测手段。
items.why_en: Targeting the vast, poorly secured IoT landscape, sequence modeling may offer a more effective route to multi-class malware detection.

items.title_zh: 混合式恶意软件检测：少样本元学习与自编码器结合
items.title_en: A Hybrid Approach to Malware Detection: Integrating Few-Shot Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning with Autoencoders
items.summary_zh: 勒索软件已成为重大网络安全威胁，在关键行业中的发生频率与影响持续上升。这类攻击通常通过钓鱼邮件、恶意下载或利用软件漏洞获得系统访问权，一旦得手便加密文件并索取加密货币赎金以换取解密密钥。传统检测方法在面对新型或样本稀少的恶意软件时往往力不从心，使系统暴露在风险之中。为应对这些挑战，论文提出一种混合方法，将少样本模型无关元学习（MAML）与自编码器相结合，以提升对稀缺或新型样本的检测能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.01949v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ransomware has emerged as a major cybersecurity threat, with incidents increasing in frequency and impact across critical sectors. These attacks are typically launched through phishing emails, malicious downloads, or exploitation of software vulnerabilities to gain system access. Once inside, the malware encrypts files and demands a ransom, often in cryptocurrency, for the decryption key. Conventional detection methods often struggle with novel or scarce samples, leaving systems vulnerable. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a hyb…
items.why_zh: 少样本学习直面新型恶意软件样本稀缺这一检测难点，若能奏效将提升对快速演化威胁的响应能力。
items.why_en: Few-shot learning directly targets the scarcity of novel malware samples, potentially improving response to fast-evolving threats.

items.title_zh: 面向测试时 AI4AI 的智能体执行环境设计元技能学习
items.title_en: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
items.summary_zh: 这项研究关注“测试时 AI-for-AI”场景：在 Builder 与 Target 两个模型的权重都保持固定的前提下，Builder 如何学会为 Target 构建更好的执行环境（harness）。作者提出 Meta-Skill，即一套原则，用于判断何时需要对 Target 提供支持、以及应当提供哪些资源，目的是让 Builder 的经验可以复用。Builder 从 Target 在开发集上的执行反馈中学习这些原则，随后利用这个冻结的技能库，为未见过的新任务构建执行环境。研究强调智能体表现不仅取决于推理能力，也取决于它所处的行动环境。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38143v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Agent performance depends on both reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts. We study test-time AI-for-AI, asking how a Builder can learn to construct better execution environments for a Target while both models' weights remain fixed. To make the Builder's experience reusable, we introduce Meta-Skill: principles specifying when support is needed and what resources to provide. The Builder learns these principles from Target's execution feedback on the development set, then uses the frozen skill bank to construct harnesses for unse…
items.why_zh: 它把环境与工具编排本身视为可学习、可迁移的技能，为权重冻结条件下提升智能体表现提供了新思路。
items.why_en: It treats environment and tool orchestration itself as a learnable, transferable skill, offering a new way to boost agent performance when model weights are frozen.

items.title_zh: UniGuardian：统一防御大模型中的提示注入、后门与对抗攻击
items.title_en: UniGuardian: A Unified Defense for Detecting Prompt Injection, Backdoor Attacks and Adversarial Attacks in Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型容易受到提示注入、后门攻击和对抗攻击的威胁，这些攻击通过操纵提示或操纵模型来产生有害输出。作者跳出传统的深度学习攻击范式，探讨这些攻击之间的内在联系，并将其统称为“提示触发攻击”（Prompt Trigger Attacks, PTA）。由此引出一个核心问题：给定一个提示，我们能否判断是否有隐藏触发器正在操控模型行为？为此他们提出 UniGuardian，据摘要介绍，这是首个基于训练的统一防御方案，可同时检测上述多类攻击。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2502.13141v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are vulnerable to attacks like prompt injection, backdoor attacks, and adversarial attacks, which manipulate prompts or models to generate harmful outputs. In this paper, departing from traditional deep learning attack paradigms, we explore their intrinsic relationship and collectively term them Prompt Trigger Attacks (PTA). This raises a key question: Given a prompt, can we tell whether a hidden trigger is steering the model's behavior? We propose UniGuardian, to the best of our knowledge the first training…
items.why_zh: 把三类攻击纳入统一框架并给出单一防御方案，有助于降低部署大模型时的安全防护成本。
items.why_en: Unifying three attack families under one framework and one defense could lower the cost of securing deployed LLMs.

items.title_zh: 把软信息“硬化”：分析师信息整合成本的证据
items.title_en: Hardening Soft Information: Evidence on Analyst Integration Costs
items.summary_zh: 论文考察把定性信息转化为精确数字估计的成本——即一种“整合成本”——如何在预期形成中造成结构性摩擦。作者利用卖方分析师报告来把整合成本与信息知悉成本、信息获取成本区分开来：同一名预测者同时产出文字叙述和数字预测，而文字所依据的信息已经被获取。因此，两类输出之间出现的任何系统性差距，都可以归因于整合成本，而不是获取信息的难度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2505.12269v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We examine how the cost of transforming qualitative information into precise numerical estimates--a form of integration cost--creates a structural friction in expectations formation. To isolate this integration cost from the costs of information awareness and acquisition, we exploit sell-side analyst reports, in which the same forecaster simultaneously produces textual narratives and numerical forecasts. Because the information underlying the text has already been acquired, any systematic gap between the two outputs can be attributed to…
items.why_zh: 它提供了可识别信息整合摩擦的实证场景，帮助理解为何分析师已知的信息未必体现在预测数字中。
items.why_en: It offers a clean empirical setting for identifying information-integration frictions, helping explain why what analysts know may not show up in their numbers.

items.title_zh: Large Reward Models：用视觉语言模型生成可泛化的机器人奖励
items.title_en: Large Reward Models: Generalizable Online Robot Reward Generation with Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 强化学习在提升机器人操作策略方面潜力巨大，但实际应用受制于奖励函数的设计：既要语义上合理，又要能跨任务复用。作者提出 Large Reward Models（LRMs）框架，把基础视觉语言模型（VLM）改造为逐帧奖励生成器，用于机器人策略的精炼。他们在覆盖真实机器人轨迹、人机物体交互等多来源数据集上对先进 VLM 进行专门化训练，使其能够在线上生成机器人任务所需的奖励。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.16065v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has shown strong potential for improving robotic manipulation policies, yet its practical use remains bottlenecked by the difficulty of specifying reward functions that are both semantically meaningful and reusable across tasks. In this paper, we propose Large Reward Models (LRMs), a framework that adapts foundation VLMs into frame-level reward generators for robot policy refinement. We specialize a state-of-the-art VLM on a multi-source dataset spanning real-world robot trajectories, human-object interaction…
items.why_zh: 若视觉语言模型能可靠生成逐帧奖励，将显著降低机器人强化学习中的奖励工程门槛。
items.why_en: If VLMs can reliably generate frame-level rewards, it would greatly lower the reward-engineering barrier for robot RL.

items.title_zh: 前沿语言模型的“口头禅”：对当前发布、研究证据与公众讨论的批判性综述
items.title_en: Verbal tics in frontier language models: A critical review of current releases, research evidence, and public discussion
items.summary_zh: 重复的赞美、套话式的安慰、熟悉的对比句式和显眼的用词，是围绕大语言模型讨论中的常见话题，其含义取决于语境：约定俗成的措辞可能有用，而流畅的回答也可能强化错误信念。这篇批判性综述考察了八个厂商家族的语言习惯与谄媚（sycophancy）现象，涵盖 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、xAI、ByteDance、Moonshot AI、DeepSeek 和小米。作者对照官方发布说明与 API 文档，核实了这些模型当前公开可用的版本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.19139v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Repeated praise, canned reassurance, familiar contrasts, and conspicuous vocabulary are recurring subjects in discussions of large language models. Their interpretation depends on context: a conventional phrase may be useful, while a fluent answer may reinforce a false belief. This critical review examines linguistic habits and sycophancy across eight developer families: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI, ByteDance, Moonshot AI, DeepSeek, and Xiaomi. We verify current public offerings against official release and API documentation…
items.why_zh: 系统梳理“AI 腔”与谄媚现象，有助于用户和研究者区分哪些只是风格问题、哪些可能强化错误认知。
items.why_en: Systematically charting "AI-speak" and sycophancy helps distinguish mere style from behaviors that can reinforce false beliefs.

items.title_zh: 面向可靠临床分诊的领域自适应小语言模型
items.title_en: Domain-Adapted Small Language Models for Reliable Clinical Triage
items.summary_zh: 在急诊科，准确而一致地分配急诊严重度指数（ESI）长期是一大难题，高度多变的自由文本分诊记录容易导致分诊失误和流程低效。本研究评估开源小语言模型（SLM）能否成为可靠、可保护隐私的临床分诊决策支持工具。作者系统比较了多个 SLM 在多种提示流程下的表现，发现“临床小案例”（clinical vignette，即分诊叙述的简明摘要）能带来更好的效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.26766v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Accurate and consistent Emergency Severity Index (ESI) assignment remains a persistent challenge in emergency departments, where highly variable free-text triage documentation contributes to mistriage and workflow inefficiencies. This study evaluates whether open-source small language models (SLMs) can serve as reliable, privacy-preserving decision-support tools for clinical triage. We systematically compared multiple SLMs across diverse prompting pipelines and found that clinical vignettes, concise summaries of triage narratives, yield…
items.why_zh: 若小模型能在本地可靠完成分诊分级，医院就可在不牺牲隐私的前提下改善急诊工作流程。
items.why_en: If small models can reliably assign triage levels locally, hospitals could improve ED workflows without sacrificing privacy.
